title: Supply coherent registered snapshots with explicit availability
statement: The Work record storage Module shall supply recorded values and availability facts from the selected registered store with a coherent state identity when established, preserving missing, invalid, inaccessible, busy, and recovery-required distinctions without returning a usable mixed snapshot.

what.problem: A query cannot give trustworthy contract, revision, or completeness information when its supporting reads combine different states or conceal missing registered content.
what.desired_outcome: The command Module receives enough exact state and availability information to produce an honest selected read.

why.rationale: SR-041 depends on a coherent source of records; MOD-011 owns this state and IF-003 even though MOD-010 is primary for logical query behavior.

stakeholders: Engineers and agents supplying explicit command requests
Maintainers of MOD-011 and its Interface consumers

conditions: A command requests a selected store snapshot or current-candidate facts while records may be absent, malformed, concurrently changing, or interrupted.

contexts: The IF-003 read boundary for one selected operational store and its manifest-declared authoritative records.

how.approach: Resolve registered authority, observe state and content coherently under the retained reader safety contract, and return distinct availability and transaction-attention outcomes for selection by the consumer.

how_much.scope: One operational store per coherent snapshot. Physical discovery does not register extra files, and the read boundary provides no atomic snapshot across all discovered changes.

acceptance_criteria: When a coherent supported snapshot is established, its recorded contract, revision, identities, and returned values describe that same observed state, including when the command selects no items or only a projection.
A supporting file gains authority only through valid manifest registration with matching record identity; extra physical files cannot silently enter the snapshot as registered records.

No entry, unregistered optional content, registered-but-missing content, malformed or unsafe content, and read failure remain distinguishable to the consumer. Selected missing content is not represented as an empty authoritative record.

Concurrent or interrupted state cannot produce a usable mixture of before and candidate records; the reader returns the applicable coherent state, busy, conflict, or recovery-required result under the retained contract and performs no recovery.

No record contract or revision is invented for an absent or invalid store. An established state identity and independently unavailable selected content retain the distinctions required by the specific read contract.
Reads leave authoritative records, transaction material, actor decisions, and historical content unchanged; factual observations remain separate from recorded values.

sources.basis: Derive this draft lower-level obligation from the containing SR at the selected command or operational-record responsibility boundary. Allocation and acceptance criteria are design claims for review, not implementation, requirement approval, or satisfaction evidence.

sources.locator: docs/design/cli/cli.md#CLI-SR-01, CLI-SR-04, CLI-SR-05, CLI-SR-14, CLI-SR-21, CLI-SR-22, CLI-SR-23; docs/design/cli/records.md#RF-SR-02, RF-SR-07
sources.basis: Preserve the applicable current public and stored-record guarantees at this accountable boundary. The named source retains exact schemas, operation tables, classifications, limits, and historical adoption obligations; this allocation neither replaces those details nor accepts REM authoring JSON as operational records.
